# 60.00 USD leaving the bank against the CAD account, on the bill side.
#
# The bill's own version of the fall-short shape. The bill owes 100.00 USD,
# the bank sent 60.00, and the other side is `Assets:Due From Director`,
# which is CAD — so the figure that split carries stood in for the payable
# and says nothing about what was paid.
#
# A block claiming `amount: 100` against this is claiming money the bank did
# not send. The settlement is read off the bank, so the run knows it is 60,
# and the refusal has to say so rather than settling the bill by 60 in
# silence.
#
# What this fixture produces: a CAD transaction, bank −60.00 USD valued
# −83.40 CAD against `Assets:Due From Director` +83.40 CAD, neither split in
# a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-28 * "Money out, short of the block"
	guid: "0c5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -60.00 USD
		guid: "5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.39"
		value: "-83.40"
	Assets:Due From Director 83.40 CAD
		guid: "6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c5f"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "83.40"
